summary: Iteration 797 verified 3 of the 4 Nova bug fixes end-to-end. FIX 1 (i18n GPS strings) confirmed via grep — en.ts/fr.ts contain help.chat.gpsLive/gpsDegraded/gpsSource/gpsFreshness with proper French translations. FIX 2 (NovaFeedbackCard visible in embedded surface) PROVEN LIVE in Playwright — thumbs-up pill click on Nova's reply opens chat-feedback-panel, all stars feedback-star-1..5 are clickable, feedback-comment and feedback-submit-btn render, submit produces feedback-success. FIX 4 ({BRAND} corruption remediation) PROVEN LIVE — after opening feedback panel and after successful submit, document.body.innerText contains 0 occurrences of literal '{BRAND}' while 'Nova' is preserved (5 occurrences); backend POST /api/i18n/auto-translate for fr locale returns clean output preserving 'Nova' with no {BRAND}; and all 23 /app/frontend/src/i18n/locales/*.ts files are free of the '{BRAND}' token. FIX 3 backend regression (test_iter796_gps_quick_questions.py) — 3/3 pass; authenticated /api/gps/state and anonymous /api/gps/state both return the 3 seeded defaults. HOWEVER, FIX 3 UI is BROKEN in the live embedded chat surface: quick-q-0/1/2 chips do NOT render on the guided-welcome state even though (a) client-side fetch of /api/gps/state returns the 3 defaults in messaging.quick_questions, (b) the LKG snapshot in localStorage (gps:last-known-good:v1) contains the 3 defaults, and (c) exported JS bundle contains the quick-q-${t} template + quickQuestions=messaging.quick_questions filter. chat-welcome is present but the qChips row is empty; none of the three default strings appear anywhere in the DOM.

ui_bugs.issue: quick-q-0, quick-q-1, quick-q-2 chips do not render on the guided-welcome state even though gpsState.messaging.quick_questions is populated (verified via in-browser fetch to /api/gps/state AND localStorage 'gps:last-known-good:v1'). chat-welcome is visible, tools row (attach/mic/GPT-5.2) shows, but the qChips View below is empty. None of the 3 seed strings ('What can you help me with?', 'How does AI coaching work?', 'How do I upgrade or manage my plan?') appear in document.body.innerText.

action_items: Debug why NovaChatPanel receives quickQuestions=[] at render time on /help embedded surface even though gpsState.messaging.quick_questions is populated in both the fresh /api/gps/state response and the LKG snapshot. Likely candidates: (a) the useMemo in help.tsx L197 using gpsState?.messaging as dep sees an initial undefined then defaults-hydrated state but the re-render never applies because of a stale closure in a parent, (b) the NovaChatPanel prop path in help.tsx L846 might be overwritten elsewhere, (c) surfaceVariant='embedded' may be triggering an unintended branch. Suggest adding a temporary console.log inside NovaChatPanel around L282 to print quickQuestions.length + isEmbedded and re-verifying in browser, or a temporary data-testid="quick-q-count" View exposing quickQuestions.length for automated inspection.

OPTIONAL: The /api/auth/me route-guard probe still bursts 401/429 (visible in console warnings [auth-session] auth_me_unauthorized + [i18n-429-monitor] auto_translate_error backoff_ms:400, queue:157). Not related to any FIX under test but continues to hurt E2E stability; add exponential backoff / single-flight coalescing.

FIX 2 verified live: NovaFeedbackCard.tsx L30 (showFeedback && !feedbackSent) — clicking a thumbs-up pill on Nova's reply now opens the inline feedback card on the embedded surface (previously suppressed for embedded/floating). Stars → comment → submit → success flow all worked in browser.
FIX 3 backend verified live (pytest 3/3) — /api/gps/state self-repairs messaging.quick_questions to the 3 defaults. In-browser fetch confirms.

FIX 3 frontend NOT verified live: help.tsx L197-200 memo appears logically correct (Array.isArray + trim().length>0 filter) and the bundle contains the wiring, but chips never render even after clicking a New Chat and waiting 6s for state hydration. Likely a state-timing or render-branch bug in NovaChatPanel — main agent should investigate before closing FIX 3.

FIX 4 verified live: auto_translate.py L32 UNRESOLVED_BRAND_TOKEN_PATTERN regex change is effective — POST /api/i18n/auto-translate for fr locale returns clean output preserving 'Nova' with no {BRAND}; document.body.innerText scans (before + after feedback submit) show 0 '{BRAND}' occurrences; all 23 locale files clean.

Minor: /app/frontend/src/hooks/useGlobalPlatformState.ts L133 defaultState.messaging = {}. If initial render happens with defaultState before LKG hydration finishes and useMemo dep [gpsState?.messaging] snapshots the {} reference, later state updates that reuse the same messaging Record ref would not fire the memo. Suggest depending on gpsState?.messaging?.quick_questions directly, or hoisting the filter into the hook so quickQuestions is always a new-array reference on state change.

rca of the issue.issue: FIX 3 frontend: quick-q chips do not render on /help embedded chat welcome despite backend and client-side state both containing the 3 defaults.
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) Login as p1.free.1779113329@example.com. 2) Navigate to /help. 3) Click Contact tab, then Chat IA sub-tab. 4) Wait for [data-testid="nova-chat-panel"] and [data-testid="chat-welcome"]. 5) Query [data-testid="quick-q-0"] → returns null. 6) Meanwhile, in the same page context evaluate `await fetch('/api/gps/state',{credentials:'include'}).then(r=>r.json()).then(j=>j.messaging.quick_questions)` → returns the 3 seed strings.
possible_root_causes: help.tsx L197-200 useMemo dep [gpsState?.messaging] may capture the initial defaultState.messaging={} reference and never re-run because the hook's LKG-merge or fetch-merge reuses the messaging object identity.
NovaChatPanel receives quickQuestions=[] because the prop chain in help.tsx L846 might be reading from a stale closure or being overridden by a sibling render branch.

A conditional inside NovaChatPanel not visible in the source diff may be gating chips on more than just showGuidedWelcome (e.g., isEmbedded plus some flag) — worth re-verifying render conditions around L282-288.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Add a temporary [data-testid="quick-q-count"] View exposing quickQuestions.length inside NovaChatPanel to confirm the received prop shape; then either (a) change the memo dep to `gpsState?.messaging?.quick_questions` (deeper path), or (b) compute the filtered list inside useGlobalPlatformState so consumers get a stable array reference that changes only when contents change.
